description: Add a continuous integration workflow that installs dependencies, runs tests and reports whether the project is healthy.
requirements: Repository should include a CI workflow file such as GitHub Actions, GitLab CI or Azure Pipelines
CI pipeline should install project dependencies
CI pipeline should run automated tests or a meaningful validation command
CI pipeline should run on pull requests or pushes to the main branch
Repository should include a successful CI run or badge link in README.md
title: Add CI Pipeline
